keyFindings.description: Line 261 names legion-infra-worker, the ServiceAccount the private deployment creates (dispatch://INFRA-321). AGENTS.md 'This repository is public' keeps names of the private infrastructure out of the tree, and the spec's Summary says the change names no project or deployment. Use a neutral name (operator-account), and change the PR body's two E2E lines that quote it.

The account fill and its grep check are written twice, once in each model-route arm (:422-425 and :431-433), with messages that already differ. The fill does not depend on the route: do it once after esac, as claude-backend-sandbox.sh:589-602 does.

Lines 93-98 re-implement lastStart (restage_test.go:104), and with no start sent the loop yields a zero LauncherStart and fails with 'names no command after --' instead of naming the missing start. Use lastStart(t, g, spec.Claim).

Fixed by the reviewer's own prose commit: the unset-account sentence at :1623 claimed no drift at all where a pod on another account is replaced; the stale-plugin list at :1812 left out account drift; :2884 and sandbox.go's accountDrift comment said the API server leaves the field as written where it writes default for a pod naming none; :4286-4287 said every live pod is replaced at its next launch where a cache pod is replaced at the sweep; sandbox.go's ReconcileOrphans comment said each drift is 'pinned'; account_drift_test.go's comments said the issue keeps its disk.
